prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-15604 Awaiting Payment
prose.body:
Hi Team at Fallowfield Games,

Hope you’re having a great week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-15604 for the recent freight services. The outstanding balance is 3674.38 USDC.

To keep things moving smoothly, please direct the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0xc7e60195831fb1d07e50d1620259c243fa83bb44. This is the same address we’ve used for previous transactions, so it should be familiar to your accounts team.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please disregard this note. Otherwise, a quick transfer would be greatly appreciated. Let us know if you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions.

Thanks so much!

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable
Upwell Freight
